description: Build a CAA (Certification Authority Authorization) DNS record (RFC 8659) from a tag plus either a domain (the CA authorized to issue, or null for a disallow-all record) or a raw value, with optional "; key=value" params and a critical flag.

critical.description: Sets flags to 128 (the critical bit) instead of 0

domain.description: Authorized CA domain for issue/issuewild/issuemail; pass null to disallow all issuance

params.description: Extra "; key=value" parameters appended after domain

value.description: Raw value to use instead of domain/params, required for tags other than issue/issuewild/issuemail

name: build_caa_record
